environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in a VPC with a public-facing Application Load Balancer. The ALB has a public DNS name and accepts connections from any source IP. No rate limiting configured. TLS terminated at ALB with direct TCP to container on port 3000. Average network latency from attacker to service: 2-5ms with low jitter. The service runs in us-east-1 and the attacker can co-locate EC2 instances in the same AZ for sub-millisecond timing resolution.
